target_claim: Under the stated hypotheses, ‖f‖ attains both a minimum and a maximum on X, even though X is not assumed nonempty.
source_quote:
So $\norm f$ attains its [[Definition:Minimum Value|minimum]] at $x$.

By replacing the [[Definition:Infimum of Mapping|infimum]] with the [[Definition:Supremum of Mapping|supremum]] in the definition of $A$, we also see that $\norm f$ attains its [[Definition:Maximum Value|maximum]] by the same reasoning.
